examples.cn: 她是我们非常尊敬的那位老师。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么在正式写作中要使用'whom'而不是'who'？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 思考主语和宾语的区别。

sentences: To ___ should I send this postcard?

image_prompts: A person writing an address on an envelope with a pen.
A mailbox with a house number and street name.
words.image_desc_en: Writing an address on an envelope. / A mailbox with an address.
words.image_desc_cn: 在信封上写地址。 / 带有地址的信箱。
words.collocations: home address, email address, change of address, mailing address

examples.en: Please write your home address on the form.
examples.cn: 请把你的家庭地址写在表格上。

examples.en: I forgot his email address, so I didn't get his reply.
examples.cn: 我忘了他的电子邮件地址，所以没收到回复。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么确保地址正确很重要？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑收到信件或包裹。

sentences: Please write your full ___ on the envelope before you send the letter.

image_prompts: A dog sitting beside its owner, looking loyal.
A student carefully copying notes from the board, being faithful to the content.
words.image_desc_en: A loyal dog sitting faithfully beside its owner. / A student faithfully copying notes.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只忠实地坐在主人身边的狗。 / 一个忠实地抄写笔记的学生。
words.collocations: serve faithfully, follow faithfully, work faithfully, promise faithfully

examples.en: The dog has faithfully accompanied its owner for many years.
examples.cn: 这只狗忠实地陪伴了主人很多年。

examples.en: She faithfully follows all the school rules.
examples.cn: 她忠实地遵守学校的各项规则。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么'忠实地'这个品质在友谊中很重要？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想一想信任和依赖。

sentences: He promised ___ to keep the secret.
